content.json:
# EasyVista ITSM ↔ Microsoft Sentinel — CISO Dashboard
---

## Solution Capabilities

This solution provides **full bidirectional integration** between Microsoft Sentinel (SecOps) and EasyVista ITSM (IT Service Management).

| Direction | Capability | Automation |
|---|---|---|
| **Sentinel → EasyVista** | Create ITSM tickets from HIGH-CONFIDENCE incidents only (High/Medium severity) | Playbook: `EasyVista-CreateIncident` |
| **Sentinel → EasyVista** | Sync incident status changes (New→Open, Active→Investigating, Closed→Resolved) | Playbook: `EasyVista-UpdateTicketStatus` |
| **Sentinel → EasyVista** | Close EasyVista ticket when incident resolved (with classification & comments) | Playbook: `EasyVista-CloseTicket` |
| **EasyVista → Sentinel** | Sync ticket status back to Sentinel incidents (Open→New, Resolved→Closed) | Playbook: `EasyVista-SyncStatusToSentinel` |
| **EasyVista → Sentinel** | Trigger security response actions from ITSM (isolate host, kill process, quarantine) | Playbook: `EasyVista-TriggerResponseActions` |
| **Bidirectional** | Enrich Sentinel investigations with ticket info (owner, SLA, status, actions) | Playbook: `EasyVista-GetTicketInfo` |
| **Data Connector** | Ingest tickets, assets, employees, and CIs into Sentinel for analytics | CCF REST API Poller |

### EasyVista Ticket Content (Full Attack Story)
Every ticket created from Sentinel includes the **complete attack narrative**, not just a single alert:

- 🚨 **Confidence Gate**: Only High/Medium severity incidents are escalated to ITSM
- 📝 **Full Attack Story**: All correlated alerts with descriptions, providers, and severity
- ⏰ **Chronological Timeline**: Events sorted oldest-to-newest as an HTML table
- 🔍 **Root Cause Analysis**: First-alert attribution, kill chain progression, and attack narrative
- 💻 **Endpoint Telemetry**: Hostname, FQDN, IP address, OS family & version, Azure AD Device ID
- 👤 **User Context**: Account name, UPN, AAD User ID, SID, account type
- 🎯 **MITRE ATT&CK Mapping**: Tactics + techniques per alert, and overall kill chain
- 🔗 **IOCs**: IP addresses, file hashes (SHA1/SHA256), URLs, and domain names
- 📋 **Recommended Actions**: Immediate response steps for the IT team

### Status Lifecycle Mapping
```
Sentinel          EasyVista
──────────────    ──────────────
New           ↔    Open
Active        ↔    Investigating
Active        ←    Contained
Closed        ↔    Resolved
```

### Low-Confidence Incidents
Incidents with **Low** or **Informational** severity are NOT sent to EasyVista. They remain in Sentinel with an `EV:Skipped-LowConfidence` tag and a comment explaining why.

---
⚠️ *Select a tab below to explore operational KPIs and analytics.*
## Executive Summary — Security ↔ ITSM Integration KPIs

content.query:
EasyVista_Tickets_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where REQUEST_TYPE has_any ("Incident", "I")
| summarize
    TotalTickets = count(),
    OpenTickets = countif(STATUS_EN !in ("Closed", "Resolved")),
    HighSeverity = countif(SEVERITY_ID <= 2),
    AvgResolutionHours = round(avg(iff(isnotempty(END_DATE_UT), datetime_diff('hour', END_DATE_UT, SUBMIT_DATE_UT), real(null))), 1),
    SLABreached = countif(isnotempty(MAX_RESOLUTION_DATE_UT) and MAX_RESOLUTION_DATE_UT < iif(isnotempty(END_DATE_UT), END_DATE_UT, now()))
content.title: Key Metrics

content.query:
EasyVista_Tickets_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where REQUEST_TYPE has_any ("Incident", "I")
| summarize TicketCount = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d), STATUS_EN
| render timechart
content.title: Security Ticket Volume Trend (Daily)

content.query:
EasyVista_Tickets_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where REQUEST_TYPE has_any ("Incident", "I")
| summarize Tickets = count() by SEVERITY_ID
| extend Severity = case(SEVERITY_ID == 1, "Critical", SEVERITY_ID == 2, "High", SEVERITY_ID == 3, "Medium", "Low")
| project Severity, Tickets
| render piechart
content.title: Incidents by Severity

content.query:
EasyVista_Tickets_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where REQUEST_TYPE has_any ("Incident", "I")
| summarize Tickets = count() by DEPARTMENT_PATH
| top 10 by Tickets
| render barchart
content.title: Top 10 Affected Departments

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Labels has "EV:"
| extend EVTicket = extract(@"EV:([^,\]]+)", 1, tostring(Labels))
| summarize
    SentinelIncidents = dcount(IncidentNumber),
    LinkedToEV = dcountif(IncidentNumber, isnotempty(EVTicket)),
    UnlinkedIncidents = dcountif(IncidentNumber, isempty(EVTicket))
| extend LinkageRate = round(100.0 * LinkedToEV / SentinelIncidents, 1)
content.title: Sentinel ↔ EasyVista Linkage Rate

content.query:
EasyVista_Tickets_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where REQUEST_TYPE has_any ("Incident", "I")
| where isnotempty(END_DATE_UT)
| extend ResolutionHours = datetime_diff('hour', END_DATE_UT, SUBMIT_DATE_UT)
| summarize
    P50 = percentile(ResolutionHours, 50),
    P75 = percentile(ResolutionHours, 75),
    P90 = percentile(ResolutionHours, 90),
    P95 = percentile(ResolutionHours, 95)
| extend P50=round(P50,1), P75=round(P75,1), P90=round(P90,1), P95=round(P95,1)
content.title: Resolution Time Percentiles (Hours)

content.query:
EasyVista_Tickets_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where REQUEST_TYPE has_any ("Incident", "I")
| where STATUS_EN !in ("Closed", "Resolved")
| project TimeGenerated, RFC_NUMBER, ['TITLE'], STATUS_EN, SEVERITY_ID, REQUESTOR_NAME, REQUESTOR_EMAIL, RECIPIENT_NAME, LOCATION_PATH, DEPARTMENT_PATH, ASSET_TAG, LAST_UPDATE
| sort by SEVERITY_ID asc, LAST_UPDATE desc
| extend Severity = case(SEVERITY_ID == 1, "🔴 Critical", SEVERITY_ID == 2, "🟠 High", SEVERITY_ID == 3, "🟡 Medium", "🟢 Low")
| project RFC_NUMBER, Severity, ['TITLE'], STATUS_EN, REQUESTOR_NAME, RECIPIENT_NAME, LOCATION_PATH, DEPARTMENT_PATH, ASSET_TAG, LAST_UPDATE
content.title: Open Security Tickets (Active Investigation)

content.query:
EasyVista_Tickets_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Tickets = count() by REQUEST_TYPE
| render piechart
content.title: Tickets by Type

content.query:
EasyVista_Tickets_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where REQUEST_TYPE has_any ("Incident", "I")
| summarize Tickets = count() by ORIGIN
| render piechart
content.title: Ticket Origin (API = Sentinel-created)

content.query:
EasyVista_Tickets_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where REQUEST_TYPE has_any ("Incident", "I")
| summarize Tickets = count() by STATUS_EN
| render piechart
content.title: Tickets by Status

content.query:
EasyVista_Tickets_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where REQUEST_TYPE has_any ("Incident", "I")
| where STATUS_EN in ("Closed", "Resolved")
| project RFC_NUMBER, ['TITLE'], SEVERITY_ID, STATUS_EN, SUBMIT_DATE_UT, END_DATE_UT, REQUESTOR_NAME, DEPARTMENT_PATH,
    ResolutionHours = round(datetime_diff('minute', END_DATE_UT, SUBMIT_DATE_UT) / 60.0, 1)
| sort by END_DATE_UT desc
| take 25
content.title: Recently Resolved Tickets

content.query:
EasyVista_Tickets_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where REQUEST_TYPE has_any ("Incident", "I")
| where isnotempty(MAX_RESOLUTION_DATE_UT)
| extend SLAStatus = iif(isnotempty(END_DATE_UT),
    iif(END_DATE_UT <= MAX_RESOLUTION_DATE_UT, "Met", "Breached"),
    iif(now() <= MAX_RESOLUTION_DATE_UT, "On Track", "At Risk"))
| summarize Tickets = count() by SLAStatus
| render piechart
content.title: SLA Compliance Overview

content.query:
EasyVista_Tickets_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where REQUEST_TYPE has_any ("Incident", "I")
| where isnotempty(MAX_RESOLUTION_DATE_UT)
| where STATUS_EN !in ("Closed", "Resolved")
| where MAX_RESOLUTION_DATE_UT < now()
| project RFC_NUMBER, ['TITLE'], SEVERITY_ID, STATUS_EN, MAX_RESOLUTION_DATE_UT, RECIPIENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_PATH,
    OverdueHours = round(datetime_diff('hour', now(), MAX_RESOLUTION_DATE_UT), 0)
| sort by OverdueHours desc
content.title: ⚠️ SLA Breached — Open Tickets Past Deadline

content.query:
EasyVista_Tickets_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where REQUEST_TYPE has_any ("Incident", "I")
| where isnotempty(END_DATE_UT)
| extend ResolutionHours = datetime_diff('hour', END_DATE_UT, SUBMIT_DATE_UT)
| extend Severity = case(SEVERITY_ID == 1, "Critical", SEVERITY_ID == 2, "High", SEVERITY_ID == 3, "Medium", "Low")
| summarize AvgHours = round(avg(ResolutionHours), 1), MedianHours = round(percentile(ResolutionHours, 50), 1), Count = count() by Severity
| sort by AvgHours asc
content.title: Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR) by Severity

content.query:
EasyVista_Tickets_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where REQUEST_TYPE has_any ("Incident", "I")
| where isnotempty(END_DATE_UT) and isnotempty(MAX_RESOLUTION_DATE_UT)
| extend SLAMet = END_DATE_UT <= MAX_RESOLUTION_DATE_UT
| summarize SLARate = round(100.0 * countif(SLAMet) / count(), 1) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| render timechart
content.title: SLA Compliance Rate Over Time (%)

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend HasEVTag = Labels has "EV:"
| summarize
    TotalIncidents = count(),
    LinkedToEV = countif(HasEVTag),
    NotLinked = countif(not(HasEVTag))
| extend LinkagePercent = round(100.0 * LinkedToEV / TotalIncidents, 1)
content.title: Incident-to-Ticket Linkage

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Labels has "EV:"
| extend EVTicket = extract(@"EV:([^,\]]+)", 1, tostring(Labels))
| join kind=leftouter (
    EasyVista_Tickets_CL
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | project RFC_NUMBER, EV_Status = STATUS_EN, EV_LastUpdate = LAST_UPDATE
) on $left.EVTicket == $right.RFC_NUMBER
| extend StatusMatch = case(
    (Status == "New" and EV_Status == "Open"), "✅ Synced",
    (Status == "Active" and EV_Status in ("Investigating", "Contained")), "✅ Synced",
    (Status == "Closed" and EV_Status in ("Resolved", "Closed")), "✅ Synced",
    "❌ Out of Sync")
| project IncidentNumber, Status, EVTicket, EV_Status, StatusMatch, LastModifiedTime, EV_LastUpdate
| sort by StatusMatch asc, LastModifiedTime desc
content.title: Status Sync Verification (Sentinel vs EasyVista)

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Labels has "EV:"
| extend EVTicket = extract(@"EV:([^,\]]+)", 1, tostring(Labels))
| join kind=leftouter (
    EasyVista_Tickets_CL
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | project RFC_NUMBER, EV_Status = STATUS_EN
) on $left.EVTicket == $right.RFC_NUMBER
| extend InSync = case(
    (Status == "New" and EV_Status == "Open"), true,
    (Status == "Active" and EV_Status in ("Investigating", "Contained")), true,
    (Status == "Closed" and EV_Status in ("Resolved", "Closed")), true,
    false)
| summarize SyncRate = round(100.0 * countif(InSync) / count(), 1) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| render timechart
content.title: Sync Rate Over Time (%)

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Status != "Closed"
| extend HasEVTag = Labels has "EV:"
| where not(HasEVTag)
| project IncidentNumber, Title, Severity, Status, CreatedTime, Owner = tostring(Owner.assignedTo)
| sort by Severity asc, CreatedTime desc
| take 20
content.title: ⚠️ Sentinel Incidents WITHOUT EasyVista Ticket

content.json: ## Security Response Actions — Triggered via EasyVista

content.query:
EasyVista_Tickets_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where DESCRIPTION has "##SECURITY_ACTION##"
| extend ActionType = case(
    DESCRIPTION has "##ISOLATE_HOST##", "Isolate Host",
    DESCRIPTION has "##KILL_PROCESS##", "Kill Process",
    DESCRIPTION has "##QUARANTINE_FILE##", "Quarantine File",
    "Other")
| summarize Actions = count() by ActionType
| render piechart
content.title: Response Actions by Type

content.query:
EasyVista_Tickets_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where DESCRIPTION has "##SECURITY_ACTION##"
| extend ActionType = case(
    DESCRIPTION has "##ISOLATE_HOST##", "Isolate Host",
    DESCRIPTION has "##KILL_PROCESS##", "Kill Process",
    DESCRIPTION has "##QUARANTINE_FILE##", "Quarantine File",
    "Other")
| extend HostTarget = extract(@"##HOSTNAME:([^#]+)##", 1, DESCRIPTION)
| project TimeGenerated, RFC_NUMBER, ActionType, HostTarget, STATUS_EN, REQUESTOR_NAME
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Response Action Log

content.query:
EasyVista_Tickets_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where DESCRIPTION has "##SECURITY_ACTION##"
| summarize Actions = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| render timechart
content.title: Response Actions Over Time
Asset Overview

content.query:
EasyVista_Assets_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| join kind=inner (
    EasyVista_Tickets_CL
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where REQUEST_TYPE has_any ("Incident", "I")
    | summarize IncidentCount = count() by ASSET_TAG
) on ASSET_TAG
| project ASSET_TAG, ASSET_LABEL, SERIAL_NUMBER, EMPLOYEE_NAME, EMPLOYEE_EMAIL, DEPARTMENT_PATH, LOCATION_PATH, IncidentCount
| sort by IncidentCount desc
| take 20
content.title: Top 20 Assets by Security Incidents

content.query:
EasyVista_Employees_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| join kind=inner (
    EasyVista_Tickets_CL
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where REQUEST_TYPE has_any ("Incident", "I")
    | summarize IncidentCount = count() by REQUESTOR_EMAIL
) on $left.E_MAIL == $right.REQUESTOR_EMAIL
| project LAST_NAME, E_MAIL, DEPARTMENT_PATH, LOCATION_PATH, IncidentCount
| sort by IncidentCount desc
| take 20
content.title: Top 20 Users by Security Incidents

content.query:
EasyVista_CIs_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize CIs = count() by CI_STATUS_EN
| render piechart
content.title: Configuration Items by Status

content.query:
EasyVista_CIs_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| join kind=inner (
    EasyVista_Tickets_CL
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where REQUEST_TYPE has_any ("Incident", "I")
    | summarize IncidentCount = count() by ASSET_TAG
) on $left.CI_ASSET_TAG == $right.ASSET_TAG
| project CI_NAME, CI_ASSET_TAG, CI_STATUS_EN, EMPLOYEE_NAME, LOCATION_PATH, IncidentCount
| sort by IncidentCount desc
| take 15
content.title: CIs Linked to Security Incidents
